prospectiveStage40Revision.reason: Stage40 is now the Act4 gameplay climax. The original3–6 and intermediate12–16 proposals are superseded. Count and boss pressure must exceed the preceding battle, without padding or changing rescue accounting.
constraints: Actual finite waves, distinct boss telegraph/counter patterns, tidal route changes
No HP-only difficulty inflation, no forced round padding
All combat and required return actions included in20R cap
Exact targets are prospective design, not measured acceptance
prospectiveStage40Revision.pairedEnemyConstraint: Unique Stage40 budget >= actual Stage39 unique budget +2; if Stage39 changes, recheck before acceptance.
prospectiveStage40Revision.supersededPrototype: 14-enemy prototype is rejected for insufficient finale scale; preserve only as local failure evidence, never release.

verticalPolicy.required: Keep intended vertical/combined stage identities and useful alternative routes, normal-input reachability, zero mandatory softlocks. Preserve terrain baseline.
forbidden: Adding floating platforms to satisfy jump quotas
Redundant traversal to inflate rounds or travel
Flattening approved varied terrain to simplify implementation
verticalPolicy.remainingReview: Do not retire campaign spatial diversity merely because jump-count requirements are relaxed.

measurement.referenceParty: Freeze actually earned skills/equipment/profile before trials; separate underprepared, normal and skilled policies.
measurement.outcomes: Retain losses, timeouts and rejected inputs. No aborting runs at20 to manufacture acceptable durations.
measurement.completion: Require objective correctness, all quantitative evidence, image review and same-candidate public checks. Gate unit tests do not establish gameplay acceptance.

supportDependency: Collector and review improvements are subtasks of Act4, not predecessor projects that halt all production.
